structure.unit: Legislative Program Review and Evaluation Act

text.section: Each study carried out pursuant to this chapter shall consider, as required: that there is a valid public need for the program or agency; that legislative intent is being carried out; that program and agency performance has been in the public interest; that program objectives have been defined; that intended program outcomes are measurable and have been accomplished; that program and agency operations are managed efficiently, economically, and effectively; or such other specific criteria as the Commission or standing committees deem necessary and desirable.
Agency self-studies may be required in such form and manner as may be directed under the resolution provided for in § 30-67.
